/*
SELECT 
    td.year,
    td.month,
    tz.Borough AS borough,
    CONVERT(DATE,td.lpep_pickup_datetime) AS trip_date,
    cal.day_name AS trip_day,
    CASE WHEN cal.day_name IN ('Saturday','Sunday') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS trip_day_weekend_ind,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.payment_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS card_trips,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.payment_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cash_trips
FROM silver.vw_trip_data_green td
JOIN silver.taxi_zone tz ON (td.PULocationID = tz.LocationID)
JOIN silver.calendar cal ON (cal.date = CONVERT(DATE,td.lpep_pickup_datetime))
JOIN silver.payment_type pt ON (td.payment_type = pt.payment_type)
WHERE td.year = '2020' AND td.month = '01'
GROUP BY td.year,
    td.month,
    tz.Borough,
    CONVERT(DATE,td.lpep_pickup_datetime),
    cal.day_name

*/


USE nyc_taxi_ldw;
DECLARE @sql NVARCHAR(MAX);

SELECT @sql = STRING_AGG(
        CAST('EXEC gold.usp_gold_trip_data_green ''' 
        + CAST(year AS VARCHAR(4)) + ''','''
        + RIGHT('0' + CAST(month AS VARCHAR(2)), 2) + ''';' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),
        CHAR(10)
    )
FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
               CAST(year AS VARCHAR(4)) AS year,
               RIGHT('0' + CAST(month AS VARCHAR(2)), 2) AS month
        FROM silver.vw_trip_data_green
     ) AS x;

PRINT(@sql);
EXEC(@sql);
